extra_vocab.en: in an official or serious way
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公告、書信、服裝與人事情境，如 formally announce（正式宣布）。強調按照正式的程序或禮節來做，語氣中性偏正式。

example.en: The CEO will formally announce the merger on Monday.
example.zh: 執行長將在星期一正式宣布這項合併案。

example.en: The board formally approved the new budget yesterday.
example.zh: 董事會昨天正式核准了新的預算。

example.en: You must formally apply for leave two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 你必須提前兩週正式申請休假。

examples.en: Please write formally when you contact a new client.
examples.zh: 聯絡新客戶時，請使用正式的寫法。

examples.en: Guests are asked to dress formally for the award dinner.
examples.zh: 賓客需穿著正式服裝出席頒獎晚宴。

examples.en: The director formally introduced the new staff at the meeting.
examples.zh: 主任在會議上正式介紹了新進員工。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音相近；formerly 是「以前、從前」，formally 是「正式地」。

example.en: The building was formerly an office for a bank.
example.zh: 這棟大樓以前是一家銀行的辦公室。

similar.diff: officially 強調經官方或主管單位認定；formally 強調形式與禮節。

example.en: The store will officially open next month.
example.zh: 這家店下個月將正式開幕。

example.en: She politely asked the client to wait a moment.
example.zh: 她有禮貌地請客戶稍等一下。

example.en: Staff can dress casually on Fridays.
example.zh: 員工星期五可以穿著輕鬆。

derived.link: 最基本的字；formal + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

extra_vocab.en: working for different companies and not for just one
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於徵才、合約與薪資情境，如 freelance writer、freelance designer。這類人通常按案件收費，不是公司的正式員工。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: freelance 當形容詞或副詞時形式不變：a freelance writer、work freelance，不加 -ly。

forms.label: 第三人稱單數
forms.zh: 接案工作（第三人稱單數）

example.en: She freelances for two travel magazines in her spare time.
example.zh: 她利用空閒時間為兩家旅遊雜誌接案。

example.en: He freelanced for three years before joining our firm.
example.zh: 他在加入我們公司前，當了三年自由工作者。

example.en: Freelancing gives her the freedom to choose her own clients.
example.zh: 自由接案讓她可以自由選擇自己的客戶。

example.en: The magazine hired a freelance writer to cover the event.
example.zh: 這本雜誌請了一位自由撰稿人來報導這場活動。

collocations.zh: 以自由工作者身分工作

example.en: He prefers to work freelance so that he can set his own hours.
example.zh: 他比較喜歡自由接案，這樣可以自己決定工作時間。

example.en: Please sign the freelance contract before you begin.
example.zh: 開始工作之前，請先簽署自由工作者合約。

examples.en: We are looking for a freelance designer for this project.
examples.zh: 我們正在為這個專案尋找一位自由接案的設計師。

examples.en: She left her job to freelance for several magazines.
examples.zh: 她辭去工作，改為替幾家雜誌接案。

examples.en: Freelance workers usually send an invoice at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 自由工作者通常在月底寄出請款單。

similar.diff: self-employed 指自己經營事業，範圍較廣；freelance 指按案接案的工作方式。

example.en: Many self-employed people work from home.
example.zh: 許多自營業者在家工作。

similar.diff: contract worker 通常與公司簽一段時間的合約；freelance 多半按案件收費。

example.en: We hired a contract worker for the busy season.
example.zh: 旺季時我們僱了一位約聘人員。

example.en: The company hired a consultant to improve its sales.
example.zh: 公司請了一位顧問來提升業績。

example.en: The contractor will finish the work by Friday.
example.zh: 承包商會在星期五前完成工作。

example.en: A freelance photographer took the pictures for our catalog.
example.zh: 一位自由接案的攝影師為我們的型錄拍了照片。

example.en: Many designers freelance while they build their own studios.
example.zh: 許多設計師在建立自己的工作室時先接案。

extra_vocab.en: to cook food in hot oil
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐飲與圖片題情境，如 frying pan（平底鍋）、fried chicken（炸雞）。名詞複數 fries 指炸薯條。

example.en: The cook fries each order fresh before serving it.
example.zh: 廚師在上菜前，每份餐點都現煎現炸。

example.en: The restaurant sells fries and drinks at a low price.
example.zh: 這家餐廳以低價販售薯條和飲料。

example.en: The kitchen fried over fifty pieces of chicken at lunch.
example.zh: 廚房午餐時間炸了超過五十塊雞肉。

example.en: Fried rice is the most popular dish on our menu.
example.zh: 炒飯是我們菜單上最受歡迎的一道菜。

example.en: Frying food at high heat can create a lot of smoke.
example.zh: 用高溫煎炸食物會產生很多煙。

example.en: Fry the chicken in oil over medium heat.
example.zh: 用中火把雞肉放在油裡煎炸。

example.en: She put the fish in a frying pan on the stove.
example.zh: 她把魚放進爐子上的平底鍋裡。

example.en: Deep-fry the potatoes for three minutes until crisp.
example.zh: 把馬鈴薯油炸三分鐘，直到變脆。

examples.en: The chef fries the fish for about five minutes.
examples.zh: 主廚把魚煎炸約五分鐘。

examples.en: Fry the onions until they turn light brown.
examples.zh: 把洋蔥炒到呈淺棕色。

examples.en: A man is frying some vegetables on the stove.
examples.zh: 一名男子正在爐子上炒蔬菜。

confusable.diff: 拼法只差一個字母；fly 是「飛、搭飛機」，fry 是「煎炸」。

example.en: I will fly to Tokyo for the trade fair next week.
example.zh: 我下週會搭飛機去東京參加貿易展。

similar.diff: cook 泛指烹調；fry 特指用油煎或炸。

example.en: Please cook the meat for ten more minutes.
example.zh: 請把肉再煮十分鐘。

example.en: They grill fresh fish for customers every evening.
example.zh: 他們每天晚上為客人烤新鮮的魚。

example.en: Boil the eggs for about ten minutes.
example.zh: 把蛋煮約十分鐘。

example.en: The bakery bakes fresh bread every morning.
example.zh: 這家麵包店每天早上烘焙新鮮麵包。

extra_vocab.en: a tool with sharp points that you use to eat food
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳與圖片題情境，如 knife and fork（刀叉）。也可指道路的分岔處，當動詞時是「分岔」。

example.en: The hotel buys new forks and spoons every year.
example.zh: 這家飯店每年都會買新的叉子和湯匙。

example.en: The road forked just after the bridge, so we stopped.
example.zh: 道路在橋後面分岔，所以我們停了下來。

example.en: The path is forking ahead, so please check the map.
example.zh: 前方的小路會分岔，請看一下地圖。

example.en: Each place setting includes a knife and fork.
example.zh: 每個座位的餐具組都有刀和叉。

example.en: The cafeteria provides a plastic fork with every takeout meal.
example.zh: 自助餐廳每份外帶餐點都附一支塑膠叉子。

example.en: The company reached a fork in the road last year.
example.zh: 公司去年走到了一個重大的轉折點。

examples.en: Please bring us two forks and some extra napkins.
examples.zh: 請幫我們多拿兩支叉子和一些餐巾紙。

examples.en: A fork and a knife were placed next to each plate.
examples.zh: 每個盤子旁邊都放著一支叉子和一把刀。

examples.en: Please add a fork and napkins to my takeout order.
examples.zh: 請在我的外帶餐點裡加上叉子和餐巾紙。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；folk 是「民間的、人們」，和餐具無關，字母 l 不發音。

example.en: Local folk music will play at the opening party.
example.zh: 當地的民謠音樂會在開幕派對上演奏。

example.en: Please give me a spoon for the soup.
example.zh: 請給我一支喝湯用的湯匙。

example.en: The knife is next to the cutting board.
example.zh: 刀子就在砧板旁邊。

example.en: The waiter put a clean plate on the table.
example.zh: 服務生在桌上放了一個乾淨的盤子。

derived.link: fork + lift，像叉子一樣把貨物舉起來的機器，常見於倉庫

example.en: Could I have a clean fork, please?
example.zh: 可以請你給我一支乾淨的叉子嗎？

example.en: The river forks into two streams just north of the town.
example.zh: 這條河在小鎮北邊分成兩條支流。

senses.en: a place where a road or river divides into two
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 road、river、left、right 等字時，指分岔處，不是叉子。

example.en: Turn left at the fork and follow the signs to the factory.
example.zh: 在岔路口左轉，然後跟著指標到工廠。

extra_vocab.en: a cover that holds papers, or a place on a computer where you keep files
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公室與電腦情境，可指裝紙本文件的文件夾，也可指電腦裡的資料夾，如 shared folder（共用資料夾）。

example.en: The cabinet holds hundreds of folders arranged by customer name.
example.zh: 這個櫃子放著數百個依客戶名稱排列的文件夾。

example.en: Create a folder for each client before you save files.
example.zh: 存檔之前，請為每位客戶建立一個資料夾。

example.en: All team members can open files in the shared folder.
example.zh: 所有團隊成員都可以開啟共用資料夾裡的檔案。

example.en: Use the project name as the folder name.
example.zh: 請用專案名稱當作資料夾名稱。

examples.en: Please put the signed contracts in the blue folder.
examples.zh: 請把簽好的合約放進藍色文件夾。

examples.en: I saved the report in a new folder on the server.
examples.zh: 我把報告存在伺服器上的一個新資料夾裡。

examples.en: Bring a folder with copies of your résumé to the interview.
examples.zh: 面試時請帶一個裝有履歷影本的文件夾。

similar.diff: binder 是有環夾、可裝很多頁的活頁夾；folder 較薄，只是對折的夾子。

example.en: Keep all invoices in the binder on the shelf.
example.zh: 請把所有發票放在架上的活頁夾裡。

example.en: I sent you the file by email this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上用電子郵件把檔案寄給你了。

example.en: Please sign this document before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請在這份文件上簽名。

example.en: The old reports are in the cabinet by the door.
example.zh: 舊報告放在門邊的櫃子裡。

derived.link: 最基本的字；fold + -er，做事的東西，folder 原指對折的紙夾，像 printer

senses.en: a cover made of paper or plastic that holds papers
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 paper、cabinet、desk、blue 等字時，指紙本文件夾。

example.en: She handed me a folder with the new price list.
example.zh: 她遞給我一個裝有新價目表的文件夾。

senses.en: a place on a computer where you keep files
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 save、open、create、server 等字時，指電腦裡的資料夾。

example.en: Drag the photos into the folder named Marketing.
example.zh: 把照片拖進名為 Marketing 的資料夾。

extra_vocab.en: to go up and down in amount or level
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於財經與市場報導，如價格、匯率、銷量上下變動。強調沒有固定的趨勢，而是一直起伏。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fluctuate 是不及物動詞，不接受詞：The price fluctuates，不說 fluctuate the price。

example.en: The stock price fluctuates every time the news changes.
example.zh: 每當消息改變，股價就會上下波動。

example.en: Our monthly sales fluctuated a lot throughout the past year.
example.zh: 我們過去一年的每月銷售額起伏很大。

example.en: Fluctuating prices make it hard to plan the budget.
example.zh: 價格上下波動，讓預算很難規劃。

collocations.zh: 在 A 和 B 之間波動

example.en: Sales fluctuate between ten and twenty units each week.
example.zh: 銷量每週在十到二十件之間起伏。

example.en: Hotel rates fluctuate widely during the holiday season.
example.zh: 假期期間，飯店房價大幅波動。

example.en: Demand tends to fluctuate with the seasons.
example.zh: 需求往往隨季節而起伏。

examples.en: Oil prices fluctuate depending on world events.
examples.zh: 油價會隨世界局勢而波動。

examples.en: The exchange rate can fluctuate by the hour.
examples.zh: 匯率每個小時都可能波動。

examples.en: Visitor numbers fluctuate with the weather in this region.
examples.zh: 這個地區的遊客人數隨天氣而起伏。

similar.diff: vary 是因地、因人而不同；fluctuate 是隨時間上下變動。

example.en: Prices vary from store to store.
example.zh: 各家店的價格不一樣。

example.en: Prices usually rise before the holiday season.
example.zh: 假期之前價格通常會上升。

example.en: Sales fall every year in the month of February.
example.zh: 每年二月的銷售額都會下降。

example.en: The company hopes to keep prices stable this year.
example.zh: 公司希望今年能維持價格穩定。

derived.link: fluctuate 去掉 -e 加 -ion，動詞變名詞，像 decorate → decoration

extra_vocab.en: a piece of equipment that is fixed in a building
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於房地產、裝修與維修情境，如 light fixture（燈具）、bathroom fixtures（浴室設備）。指固定在建築物上、不能隨便搬走的設備。

example.en: The landlord paid for repairs to all the fixtures.
example.zh: 房東支付了所有固定設備的維修費。

example.en: The electrician installed a new light fixture in the hallway.
example.zh: 電工在走廊裝了一個新的燈具。

example.en: The hotel upgraded every bathroom fixture last spring.
example.zh: 這家飯店去年春天更新了每一項浴室設備。

example.en: The price covers all fixtures and fittings in the building.
example.zh: 這個價格包含大樓內所有的固定裝置與配件。

examples.en: The sale includes all fixtures and the kitchen equipment.
examples.zh: 這次出售包含所有固定設備與廚房用具。

examples.en: The plumber replaced an old fixture in the restroom.
examples.zh: 水電工換掉了洗手間裡一個舊的設備。

examples.en: Store fixtures such as shelves must be installed before opening.
examples.zh: 貨架等店面設備必須在開幕前裝好。

confusable.diff: furniture 是可以搬動的家具；fixture 是固定在建築物上的設備。
confusable.usage: furniture 是不可數名詞，不加 s；fixture 是可數名詞，複數是 fixtures。

example.en: We need new furniture for the meeting room.
example.zh: 我們需要為會議室添購新家具。

similar.diff: fitting 多指較小的配件或零件；fixture 是固定在建築上的整件設備。

example.en: The company supplies fittings for hotel rooms.
example.zh: 這家公司供應飯店客房用的配件。

example.en: A technician will install the new lights tomorrow.
example.zh: 技師明天會安裝新的燈具。

example.en: The gym bought new equipment last month.
example.zh: 健身房上個月添購了新設備。

derived.link: 最基本的字；fix + -ture，名詞字尾，指固定好的東西，像 picture、furniture 的字尾

extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to stop fires
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於圖片題、安全公告與新聞情境。firefighter 不分性別，現在比 fireman 更常用。

example.en: Firefighters checked every room before allowing staff to return.
example.zh: 消防員檢查了每個房間後，才讓員工回去。

example.en: My neighbor works as a volunteer firefighter on weekends.
example.zh: 我的鄰居週末擔任義勇消防員。

example.en: A team of firefighters arrived within five minutes.
example.zh: 一隊消防員在五分鐘內抵達。

example.en: The company offers firefighter training to its safety staff.
example.zh: 公司為安全人員提供消防訓練。

examples.en: A firefighter is holding a hose in front of the building.
examples.zh: 一名消防員在大樓前拿著水管。

examples.en: Local firefighters will visit our office to explain safety rules.
examples.zh: 當地的消防員會來我們辦公室說明安全規定。

examples.en: The firefighter helped everyone leave the building safely.
examples.zh: 這位消防員協助大家安全離開大樓。

similar.diff: fireman 較舊，通常指男性；firefighter 不分性別，更常用。

example.en: The fireman rescued a cat from the roof.
example.zh: 消防員從屋頂救下了一隻貓。

example.en: Everyone left the building when the fire alarm rang.
example.zh: 火災警報響起時，大家都離開了大樓。

example.en: Call this number in case of an emergency.
example.zh: 遇到緊急情況時，請撥打這個號碼。

example.en: The team rescued two workers from the roof.
example.zh: 救援隊從屋頂救出了兩名工人。
